verses: Alif Laam Ra, yeh aik aisi kitab hai kay uss ki aayaten mohkum ki gaee hain, phir saaf saaf biyan ki gaee hain aik hakeem ba-khabar ki taraf say
Yeh kay Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat mat kero mein tum ko Allah ki taraf say daraney wala aur bisharat denay wala hun

Aur yeh kay tum log apney gunah apney rab say moaf kerao phir ussi ki taraf mutawajha raho, woh tum ko waqt muqarrar tak acha saman (zindagi) dey ga aur her ziyadah amal kerney walay ko ziyadah sawab dey ga. Aur agar tum log aeyraaz kertay rahey to mujh ko tumharay liye aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai
Tum ko Allah hi kay pass jana hai aur woh her shey per poori qudrat rakhta hai

Yaad rakho woh log apney seenon ko dohra kiye detay hain takay apni baaten (Allah) say chupa saken. Yaad rakho kay woh log jiss waqt apney kapray lapettay hain woh uss waqt bhi sab janta hai jo kuch chupatay hain aur jo kuch woh zahir kertay hain. Bil-yaqeen woh dilon kay andar ki baaten janta hai

Zamin per chalney phirney walay jitney jaandaar hain sab ki roziyan Allah Taalaa per hain o hi unn kay rehney sehney ki jagah ko janta hai aur unn kay sonpay janey ki jagah ko bhi, sab kuch wazeh kitab mein mojood hai

Allah hi woh hai jiss ney chhe din mein aasman o zamin ko peda kiya aur uss ka arsh pani per tha takay woh tumhen aazmaye kay tum mein say achay amal wala kaun hai, agar aap unn say kahen kay tum log marney kay baad utha kharay kiye jao gay to kafir log palat ker jawab den gay kay yeh to nira saaf saaf jadoo hi hai

Aur agar hum unn say azab ko gini chuni muddat tak kay liye peechay daal den to yeh zaroor pukar uthen gay kay azab ko kaun si cheez rokay huye hai, suno! jiss din woh unn kay pass aaye ga phir unn say talney wala nahi phir to jiss cheez ki hansi ura rahey thay woh unhen gher ley gi
Aur agar hum insan ko apni kissi nemat ka zaeeqa chakha ker phir ussay uss say ley len to woh boht hi na-umeed aur bara hi nashukra bann jata hai
Aur agar hum ussay koi nemat chakhayen uss sakhti kay baad jo ussay phonch chuki thi to woh kehney lagta hai kay bus buraiyan mujh say jati rahen, yaqeenan woh bara hi itraney wala shekhi khor hai
Siwaye unn kay jo sabar kertay hain aur nek kaamon mein lagay rehtay hain. Unhi logon kay liye bakhsish bhi hai aur boht bara nek badla bhi

Pus shayad kay aap uss wahee kay kissi hissay ko chor denay walay hain jo aap ki taraf nazil ki jati hai aur uss say aap ka dil tang hai, sirf unn ki uss baat per kay uss per koi khazana kiyon nahi itra? Ya uss kay sath koi farishta hi aata, sunn lijiye! aap to sirf daraney walay hi hain aur her cheez ka zimmay daar Allah Taalaa hai

Kiya yeh kehtay hain kay uss Quran ko ussi ney ghara hai. Jawab dijiye kay phir tum bhi ussi ki misil das surten ghari hui ley aao aur Allah kay siwa jissay chahao apney sath bula bhi lo agar tum sachay ho

Phir agar woh tumhari uss baat ko qabool na keren to tum yaqeen say jaan lo kay yeh Quran Allah kay ilm kay sath utara gaya hai aur yeh kay Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi, pus kiya tum musalman hotay ho?
Jo shakhs duniya ki zindagi aur uss ki zeenat per farifta hua chahata ho hum aison ko unn kay kul aemaal (ka badla) yehi bharpoor phoncha detay hain aur yahan unhen koi kami nahi ki jati
Haan yehi woh log hain jin kay liye aakhirat mein siwaye aag kay aur kuch nahi aur jo kuch unhon ney yahan kiya hoga o haan sab ikaarat hai aur jo kuch unn aemaal thay sab barbaad honey walay hain

Kiya woh shakhs jo apney rab kay pass ki daleel per ho aur uss kay sath Allah ki taraf ka gawah ho aur uss say pehlay Musa ki kitab (gawah ho) jo paishwa aur rehmat hai (auron kay barabar ho sakta hai?) yehi log hain jo uss per eman rakhtay hain, aur tamam firqon mein say jo bhi uss ka munkir ho uss kay aakhri waday ki jagah jahannum hai, pus to uss mein kissi qasam kay shuba)yeh mein na reh, yaqeenan yeh teray rab ki janib say sirasir bar-haq hai, lekin aksar log eman laney walay nahi hotay

Uss say barh ker zalim kaun hoga jo Allah jhoot bandhay yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney paish kiye jayen gay aur saray gawah kahen gay kay yeh woh log hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar per jhoot bandha, khabardaar ho kay Allah ki laanat hai zalimon per
Jo Allah ki raah say roktay hain aur uss mein kuji talash ker letay hain. Yehi aakhirat kay munkir hain
Na yeh log duniya mein Allah ko hara sakay aur na unn ka koi himayati Allah kay siwa hua, unn kay liye azab dugna kiya jaye ga na yeh sunnay ki taqat rakhtay thay aur na yeh dekhtay hi thay
Yehi hain jinhon ney apna nuksan aap ker liya aur woh sab kuch unn say kho gaya, jo unhon ney gharr rakha tha
Be-shak yehi log aakhirat mein ziyan kaar hun gay
Yaqeenan jo log eman laye aur unhon ney kaam bhi nek kiye aur apney paalney walay ki taraf jhuktay rahey, o hi jannat mein janey walay hain, jahan woh hamesha hi rehney walay hain
Unn dono firqon ki misal andhay, behray aur dekhney, sunnay walay jaisi hai. Kiya yeh dono misal mein barabar hain? Kiya phir bhi tum naseehat hasil nahi kertay?
Yaqeenan hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko uss ki qom ki taraf rasool bana ker bheja kay mein tumhen saaf saaf hoshiyaar ker denay wala hun
Kay tum sirf Allah hi ki ibadat kero, mujhay to tum per dard-naak din kay azab ka khof hai

Uss ki qom kay kafiron kay sardaron ney jawab diya kay hum to tujhay apney jaisa insan hi dekhtay hain aur teray tabeydaron ko bhi hum dekhtay hain kay yeh log wazeh tor per siwaye neech logon kay aur koi nahi jo bey sochay samajh (tumhari pairwee ker rahey hain), hum to tumhari kissi qasam ki bartari apney upper nahi dekh rahey, balkay)yeh hum to tumhen jhoota samajh rahey hain

Nooh ney kaha, meri qom walo! mujhay batao to agar mein apney rab ki taraf say kissi daleel per hua aur mujhay uss ney apney pass ki koi rehmat ata ki ho, phir woh tumhari nigahon mein na aaee to kiya zabardasti mein ussay tumharay galay mandh doon, halankay tum uss say beyzaar ho

Meri qom walo! mein tum say uss per koi maal nahi mangta. Mera sawab to sirf Allah Taalaa kay haan hai na mein eman walon ko apney pass say nikal sakta hun, unhen apney rab say milna hai lekin mein dekhta hun kay tum log jahalat ker rahey ho
Meri qom kay logo! agar mein unn mominon ko apney pass say nikal doon to Allah kay muqabla mein meri madad kaun ker sakta hai? Kiya tum kuch bhi naseehat nahi pakartay

Mein tum say nahi kehta kay meray pass Allah kay khazaney hain, (suno!) mein ghaib ka ilm bhi nahi rakhta, na mein yeh kehta hun kay mein koi farishta hun, na mera yeh qol hai kay jin per tumhari nigahen zillat say parr rahi hain unhen Allah Taalaa koi nemat dey ga hi nahi, unn kay dil mein jo hai ussay Allah hi khoob janta hai, agar mein aisi baat kahon to yaqeenan mera shumar zalimon mein ho jaye ga
(qom kay logon ney) kaha aey Nooh! tu ney hum say behas ker li aur khoob behas ker li. Abb to jiss cheez say humen dhamka raha hai o hi humaray pass ley aa, agar to sachon mein hai
Jawab diya kay ussay bhi Allah Taalaa hi laye ga agar woh chahaye aur haan tum ussay haraney walay nahi ho

Tumhen meri khair khuwahi kuch bhi nafa nahi dey sakti, go mein kitni hi tumhari khair khuwahi kiyon na chahaon, ba-shart-e-kay Allah ka iradah tumhen gumrah kerney ka ho, o hi tum sab ka perwerdigar hai aur ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Kiya yeh kehtay hain kay ussay khud ussi ney gharr liya hai? To jawab dey kay agar mein ney ussay gharr liya ho to mera gunah mujh per hai aur mein unn gunahon say buri hun jo tum ker rahey ho
Nooh ki taraf wahee bheji gaee kay teri qom mein say jo eman laa chukay unn kay siwa aur koi abb eman laye ga hi nahi, pus to unn kay kaamon per ghumgeen na ho
Aur aik kashti humari aankhon kay samney aur humari wahee say tayyar ker aur zalimon kay baray mein hum say koi baat cheet na ker woh pani mein dobo diye janey walay hain

Woh (Nooh) kashti bananey lagay unn ki qom kay jo sardar unn kay pass say guzartay woh unn ka mazaq uratay, woh kehtay agar tum humara mazaq uratay ho to hum bhi tum per aik din hansen gay jaisay tum hum per hanstay ho
Tumhen boht jald maloom ho jaye ga kay kiss per azab aata hai jo ussay ruswa keray aur uss per hameshgi ki saza utar aaye

Yahan tak kay jab humara hukum phoncha aur tanoor ubalney laga hum ney kaha kay uss kashti mein her qasam kay (jaandaron mein say) joray (yani) do (janwar, aik nurr aur aik madah) sawar kera ley aur apney ghar kay logon ko bhi, siwaye unn kay jin per pehlay say baat parr chuki hai aur sab eman walon ko bhi, uss kay sath eman laney walay boht hi kum thay
Nooh) alaihi as-salam (ney kaha, uss kashti mein beth jao Allah hi kay naam say uss ka chalna aur theharna hai, yaqeenan mera rab bari bakhsish aur baray reham wala hai

Woh kashti unhen paharon jaisi mojon mein ley ker jaa rahi thi aur Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney apney larkay ko jo aik kinaray per tha, pukar ker kaha kay aey meray piyaray bachay humaray sath sawar ho jaa aur kafiron mein shamil na reh

Uss ney jawab diya kay mein to kissi baray pahar ki taraf panah mein aajaon ga jo mujhay pani say bacha ley ga, Nooh) alaihi as-salam (ney kaha aaj Allah kay amar say bachaney wala koi nahi, sirf o hi bachen gay jin per Allah ka reham hua. Ussi waqt unn dono kay darmiyan moj haeel hogaee aur woh dobney walon mein say hogaya

Farma diya gaya kay aey zamin apney pani ko nigal jaa aur aey aasman bus ker thum jaa, ussi waqt pani sikha diya gaya aur kaam poora ker diya gaya aur kashti jodi naami pahar per jaa lagi aur farma diya gaya kay zalim logon per laanat nazil ho

Nooh) alaihi as-salam (ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara aur kaha kay meray rab mera beta to meray ghar walon mein say hai, yaqeenan tera wada bilkul sacha hai aur to tamam hakimon say behtar haakim hai

Allah Taalaa ney farmaya aey Nooh yaqeenan woh teray gharaney say nahi hai, uss kay kaam bilkul hi shaista hain tujhay hergiz woh cheez na maangni chahaiye jiss ka tujhay mutlaqan ilm na ho mein tujhay naseehat kerta hun kay to jahilon mein say apna shumar keraney say baaz rahey

Nooh ney kaha meray palanhaar mein teri hi panah chahata hun uss baat say kay tujh say woh maangoon jiss ka mujhay ilm hi na ho agar to mujhay na bakhshay ga aur to mujh per reham na farmaye ga, to mein khasarah paney walon mein ho jaon ga

Farma diya gaya kay aey Nooh! humari janib say salamti aur unn barkaton kay sath utar, jo tujh per hain aur teray sath ki boht si jamaton per aur boht si woh ummaten hun gi jinhen hum faeedah to zaroor phonchayen gay lekin phir unhen humari taraf say dard-naak azab phonchay ga

Yeh khabren ghaib ki khabron mein say hain jin ki wahee hum aap ki taraf kertay hain unhen uss say pehlay aap jantay thay aur na aap ki qom, uss liye aap sabar kertay rahiye (yaqeen maniyey) kay anjam kaar perhezgaron kay liye hi hai
Aur qom aad ki taraf unn kay bhai Hood ko hum ney bheja, uss ney kaha meri qom walo! Allah hi ki ibadat kero, uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi, tum to sirf bohtan bandh rahey ho
Aey meri qom! mein tum say uss ki koi ujrat nahi mangta, mera ajar uss kay zimmay hai jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai to kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay

Aey meri qom kay logo! tum apney paalney walay say apni taqseeron ki moafi talab kero aur uss ki janab mein tauba kero, takay woh barasney walay badal tum per bhej dey aur tumhari taqat per aur taqat qooat barha dey aur tum jurum kertay huye roo-gardani na kero
Unhon ney kaha aey Hood! to humaray pass koi daleel to laya nahi aur hum sirf teray kehney say apney maboodon ko chorney walay nahi aur na hum tujh per eman laney walay hain

Balkay)yeh hum to yehi kehtay hain kay to humaray kissi mabood kay buray jhaptay mein aagaya hai. Uss ney jawab diya kay mein Allah ko gawah kerta hun aur tum bhi gawah raho kay mein to Allah kay siwa unn sab say beyzaar hun, jinhen tum shareek bana rahey ho
Acha tum sab mill ker meray khilaf chalen chal lo aur mujhay bilkul mohlat bhi na do
Mera bharosa sirf Allah Taalaa per hi hai, jo mera aur tum sab ka perwerdigar hai jitney bhi paon dharney walay hain sab ki peshani o hi thamay huye hai. Yaqeenan mera rab bilkul sahih raah per hai

Pus agar tum roo-gardani kero to kero mein to tumhen woh paygham phoncha chuka jo dey ker mujhay tumhari taraf bheja gaya tha. Mera rab tumharay qaeem muqam aur logon ko ker dey ga aur tum uss ka kuch bhi bigar na sako gay, yaqeenan mera perwerdigar her cheez per nigehbaan hai
Aur jab humara hukum phoncha to hum ney Hood ko aur uss kay musalman sathiyon ko apni khaas rehmat say nijat ata farmaee aur hum ney unn sab ko sakht azab say bacha liya
Yeh thi qom aad, jinhon ney apney rab ki aayaton ka inkar kiya aur uss kay rasoolon ki na-farmani ki aur her aik sirkash nafarman kay hukum ki tabeydaari ki
Duniya mein bhi unn kay peechay laanat laga di gaee aur qayamat kay din bhi, dekh lo qom aad ney apney rab say kufur kiya, Hood ki qom aad per doori ho

Aur qom samood ki taraf unn kay bhai saleh ko bheja, uss ney kaha kay aey meri qom tum Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi, ussi ney tumhen zamin say peda kiya hai aur ussi ney uss zamin mein tumhen basaya hai, pus tum uss say moafi talab kero aur uss ki taraf rujoo kero. Be-shak mera rab qareeb aur duaon ka qabool kerney wala hai

Unhon ney kaha aey saleh! uss say pehlay to hum tujh say boht kuch umeeden lagaye huye thay, kiya to humen unn ki ibadaton say rok raha hai jin ki ibadat humaray baap dada kertay chalay aaye, humen to uss deen mein heyraan kun shak hai jiss ki taraf to humen bula raha hai

Uss ney jawab diya kay aey meri qom kay logo! zara batao to agar mein apney rab ki taraf say kissi mazboot daleel per hua aur uss ney mujhay apney pass ki rehmat ata ki ho, phir agar mein ney uss ki na-farmani ker li to kaun hai jo uss kay muqablay mein meri madad keray? Tum to mera nuksan hi barha rahey ho

Aur aey meri qom walo! yeh Allah ki bheji hui oontni hai jo tumharay liye aik moajza hai abb tum ussay Allah ki zamin mein khati hui chor do aur ussay kissi tarah ki ezza na phonchao werna fori azab tumhen pakar ley ga
Phir bhi unn logon ney uss oontni kay paon kaat dalay, uss per saleh ney kaha kay acha tum apney gharon mein teen teen din tak to reh seh lo, yeh wada jhoota nahi hai
Phir jab humara farman phoncha, hum ney saleh ko aur unn per eman laney walon ko apni rehmat say uss say bhi bacha liya aur uss din ki ruswaee say bhi. Yaqeenan tera rab nihayat tawana aur ghalib hai
Aur zalimon ko baray zor ki chinghar ney dabocha, phir to woh apney gharon mein ondhay paray huye reh gaye
Aisay kay goya woh o haan kabhi abad hi na thay, aagah raho kay qom samood ney apney rab say kufur kiya. Sunn lo! unn samoodiyon per phitkaar hai
Aur humaray bhejay huye payghaamber Ibrahim kay pass khushkhabri ley ker phonchay aur salam kaha, unhon ney bhi jawab salam diya aur baghair kissi takheer kay gaaye ka bhuna hua bachra ley aaye

Abb jo dekha kay unn kay to hath bhi uss ki taraf nahi phonch rahey to unn say ajnabiyat mehsoos kerkay dil hi dil mein unn say khof kerney lagay, unhon ney kaha daro nahi hum to qom Loot ki taraf bhejay huye aaye hain
Uss ki biwi jo khari hui thi woh hans pari, to hum ney ussay Ishaq ki aur Ishaq kay peechay Yaqoob ki khushkhabri di
Woh kehney lagi haaye meri kum bakhti! meray haan aulad kaisay ho sakti hai mein khud burhiya aur yeh meray khawind bhi boht bari umar kay hain yeh to yaqeenan bari ajeeb baat hai

Farishton ney kaha kiya to Allah ki qudrat say tajjub ker rahi hai? Tum per aey uss ghar kay logo Allah ki rehmat aur uss ki barkaten nazil hun, be-shak Allah hamd o sana ka sazawaar aur bari shaan wala hai
Jab Ibrahim ka darr khof jata raha aur ussay bisharat bhi phonch chuki to hum say qom Loot kay baray mein kehney sunnay lagay
Yaqeenan Ibrahim boht tahammul walay naram dil aur Allah ki janib jhukney walay thay
Aey Ibrahim! uss khayal ko chor dijiye, aap kay rab ka hukum phoncha hai, aur unn per na taalay janey wala azab zaroor aaney wala hai
Jab humaray bhejay huye farishtay Loot kay pass phonchay to woh unn ki wajah say boht ghumgeen hogaye aur dil hi dil mein kurhney lagay aur kehney lagay kay aaj ka din bari museebat ka din hai

Aur uss ki qom dorti hui uss kay pass phonchi, woh to pehlay hi say kaariyon mein mubtila thi, Loot) alaihi as-salam (ney kaha aey qom kay logo! yeh hain meri betiyan jo tumharay liye boht hi pakeezah hain, Allah say daro aur mujhay meray mehmanon kay baray mein ruswa na kero, kiya tum mein aik bhi bhala aadmi nahi
Unhon ney jawab diya kay to bakhoobi janta hai kay humen to teri betiyon per koi haq nahi hai aur to humari asli chahat say bakhoobi waqif hai
Loot) alaihi as-salam (ney kaha kaash kay mujh mein tum say muqabla kerney ki qooat hoti ya mein kissi zabardast ka aasra pakar pata

Abb farishton ney kaha aey Loot! hum teray perwerdigar kay bhejay huye hain na-mumkin hai kay yeh tujh tak phonch jayen pus to apney ghar walon ko ley ker kuch raat rahey nikal khara ho. Tum mein say kissi ko murr ker bhi na dekhna chahaiye, ba-juz teri biwi kay, uss liye kay ussay bhi o hi phonchney wala hai jo unn sab ko phonchay ga, yaqeenan unn kay waday ka waqt subha ka hai, kiya subha bilkul qareeb nahi
Phir jab humara hukum phoncha, hum ney uss basti ko zer zair-o-zabar ker diya upper ka hissa neechay ker diya aur unn per kankreelay pathar barsaye jo teh ba teh thay
Teray rab ki taraf say nishan daar thay aur woh unn zalimon say kuch bhi door na thay

Aur hum ney madiyan walon ki taraf unn kay bhai Shoaib ko bheja, uss ney kaha aey meri qom! Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi aur tum naap tol mein bhi kami na kero mein to tumhen aasoodah haal dekh raha hun aur mujhay tum per gherney walay din kay azab ka khof (bhi) hai
Aey meri qom! naap tol insaf kay sath poori poori kero logon ko unn ki cheezen kum na do aur zamin mein fasad aur kharabi na machao
Allah Taalaa ka halal kiya hua jo bach rahey tumharay liye boht hi behtar hai agar tum eman walay ho, mein tum per kuch nigehbaan (aur daroghah) nahi hun

Unhon ney jawab diya kay aey Shoaib! kiya teri salat tujhay yehi hukum deti hai kay hum apney baap dadon kay maboodon ko chor den aur hum apney maalon mein jo kuch chahayen uss ka kerna bhi chor den to to bara hi baq-waqar aur nek chalan aadmi hai

Kaha aey meri qom! dekho to agar mein apney rab ki taraf say roshan daleel liye huye hun aur uss ney mujhay apney pass say behtareen rozi dey rakhi hai, mera yeh iradah bilkul nahi kay tumhara khilaf ker kay khud uss cheez ki taraf jhuk jaon jiss say tumhen rok raha hun, mera iradah to apni taqat bhar islaah kerney ka hi hai. Meri tofiq Allah hi ki madad say hai, ussi per mera bharosa hai aur ussi ki taraf mein rujoo kerta hun

Aur aey meri qom (kay logo!) kahen aisa na ho kay tum ko meri mukhalifat unn azabon ka mustahiq bana dey jo qom Nooh aur qom Hood aur qom saleh ko phonchay hain. Aur qom Loot to tum say kuch door nahi
Tum apney rab say istaghfaar kero aur uss ki taraf tauba kero, yaqeen mano kay mera rab bari meharbani wala aur boht mohabbat kerney wala hai

Unhon ney kaha aey Shoaib! teri aksar baaten to humari samajh mein hi nahi aatin aur hum to tujhay apney andar boht kamzor patay hain, agar teray qabeelay ka khayal na hota to hum to tujhay sangsaar ker detay, aur hum tujhay koi heysiyat wali hasti nahi gintay

Unhon ney jawab diya kay aey meri qom kay logo! kiya tumharay nazdeek meray qabeelay kay log Allah say bhi ziyadah zee izzat hain kay tum ney ussay pus pusht daal diya hai yaqeenan mera rab jo kuch tum ker rahey ho sab ko gheray huye hai

Aey meri qom kay logo! abb tum apni jagah amal kiye jao mein bhi amal ker raha hun, tumhen unqareeb maloom ho jaye ga kay kiss kay pass woh azab aata hai jo ussay ruswa ker dey aur kaun hai jo jhoota hai. Tum intizar kero mein bhi tumharay sath muntazir hun

Jab humara hukum (azab) phoncha hum ney Shoaib ko aur unn kay sath (tamam) mominon ko apni khaas rehmat say nijat bakhshi aur zalimon ko sakht chinghar kay azab ney dhar dabocha jiss say woh apney gharon mein ondhay paray huye hogaye
Goya kay woh unn gharon mein kabhi basay hi na thay, aagah raho madiyan kay liye bhi wesi hi doori ho jaisi doori samood ko hui
Aur yaqeenan hum ney hi Musa ko apni aayaat aur roshan daleelon kay sath bheja tha
Firaun aur uss kay sardaron ki taraf, phir bhi unn logon ney Firaun kay ehkaam ki pairwee ki aur Firaun ka koi hukum durust tha hi nahi
Woh to qayamat kay din apni qom ka paish roo ho ker unn sab ko dozakh mein jaa khara keray ga, woh boht hi bura ghaat hai jiss per laa kharay kiye jayen gay
Unn per to uss duniya mein bhi laanat chipka di gaee aur qayamat kay din bhi bura inam hai jo diya gaya
Bastiyon ki yeh baaz khabren jinhen hum teray samney biyan farma rahey hain unn mein say baaz to mojood hain aur baaz (ki faslen) kat gaee hain

Hum ney unn per koi zulm nahi kiya, balkay)yeh khud unhon ney hi apney upper zulm kiya, aur unhen unn kay maboodon ney koi faeedah na phonchaya jinhen woh Allah kay siwa pukara kertay thay, jab kay teray perwerdigar ka hukum phoncha, balkay)yeh aur unn ka nuksan hi unhon ney barha diya
Teray perwerdigar ki pakar ka yehi tareeqa hai jab kay woh bastiyon kay rehney walay zalimon ko pakarta hai be-shak uss ki pakar dukh denay wali aur nihayat sakht hai
Yaqeenan uss mein unn logon kay liye nishan ibrat hai jo qayamat kay azab say dartay hain. Woh din jiss mein sab log jama kiye jayen gay aur woh, woh din hai jiss mein sab hazir kiye jayen gay
Ussay hum jo mulatawee kertay hain woh sirf aik muddat moyyen tak hai
Jiss din woh aajaye gi majal na hogi kay Allah ki ijazat kay baghair koi baat bhi ker ley, so unn mein koi badbakht hoga aur koi nek bakht
Lekin jo badbakht huye woh dozakh mein hun gay o haan cheekhen gay chillayen gay
Woh o hain hamesha rehney walay hain jab tak aasman o zamin bar-qarar rahen. Siwaye uss waqt kay jo tumhara rab chahaye. Yaqeenan tera rab jo kuch chahaye ker guzarta hai
Lekin jo nek bakht kiye gaye woh jannat mein hun gay jahan hamesha rahen gay jab tak aasman o zamin baqi rahey magar jo tera perwerdigar chahaye. Yeh bey inteha bakhsish hai

Uss liye aap unn cheezon say shak o shuba)yeh mein na rahen jinhen yeh log pooj rahey hain, unn ki pooja to uss tarah hai jiss tarah unn kay baap dadon ki uss say pehlay thi. Hum unn sab ko unn ka poora poora hissa baghair kissi kami kay denay walay hi hain

Yaqeenan hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko kitab di. Phir uss mein ikhtilaf kiya gaya, agar pehlay hi aap kay rab ki baat sadir na hogaee hoti to yaqeenan unn ka faisla ker diya jata, unhen to uss mein sakht shuba)yeh hai
Yaqeenan mein say her aik jab unn kay roo-baroo jaye ga to aap ka rab ussay uss kay aemaal ka poora poora badla dey ga. Be-shak woh jo ker rahey hain unn say woh ba-khabar hai
Pus aap jamay rahiye jaisa kay aap ko hukum diya gaya hai aur woh log bhi jo aap kay sath tauba ker chukay hain, khabardaar tum hadd say na barhna, Allah tumharay tamam aemaal ka dekhney wala hai
Dekho zalimon ki taraf hergiz na jhukna werna tumhen bhi (dozakh ki) aag lag jaye gi aur Allah kay siwa aur tumhara madadgar na khara ho sakay ga aur na tum madad diye jao gay
Din kay dono saron mein namaz barpa rakh aur raat ki kaee sa’aton mein bhi, yaqeenan nekiyan buraiyon ko door ker deti hain. Yeh naseehat hai naseehat pakarney walon kay liye
Aap sabar kertay rahiye yaqeenan Allah Taalaa neki kerney walon ka ajar zaya nahi kerta

Pus kiyon na tum say pehlay zamaney kay logon mein say aisay ahl khair log huye jo zamin mein fasad phelaney say roktay, siwaye unn chand kay jinhen hum ney unn mein say nijat di thi, zalim log to uss cheez kay peechay parr gaye jiss mein unhen aasoodgi di gaee thi aur woh gunehgar thay
Aap ka rab aisa nahi kay kissi basti ko zulm say halak ker dey aur o haan kay log neko kaar hun
Agar aap ka perwerdigar chahata to sab logon ko aik hi raah per aik giroh ker deta. Woh to barabar ikhtilaf kerney walay hi rahen gay
Ba-juz unn kay jin per aap ka rab reham farmaye, unhen to ussi liye peda kiya hai, aur aap kay rab ki yeh baat poori hai kay mein jahannum ko jinno aur insano sab say per keroon ga
Rasoolon kay sab ehwaal hum aap kay samney aap kay dil ki taskeen kay liye biyan farma rahey hain. Aap kay pass uss surat mein bhi haq phonch chuka jo naseehat o waaz hai mominon kay liye
Eman na laney walon say keh dijiye kay tum apney tor per amal kiye jao hum bhi amal mein mashghool hain
Aur tum bhi intizar kero hum bhi muntazir hain

Zaminon aur aasmano ka ilm ghaib Allah Taalaa hi ko hai, tamam moamlaat ka rujoo bhi ussi ki janib hai, pus tujhay ussi ki ibadat kerni chahaiye aur ussi per bharosa rakhna chahaiye aur tum jo kuch kertay ho uss say Allah Taalaa bey khabar nahi
